payload.description:
## Why this exists
kbs-3b5cc3 removed the NAT Gateway and replaced TenantSyncWorker with GitSync + EFS Writer + SyncNotify. That slice is merged on develop (PR #201) and a disposable tenant (`preaccept/accept-135301`) synced successfully.

That is not the hosted product.

## Gap
- S3 bucket `kanbus-sync-dev-335163751677` has only `preaccept/`. There is no `anthus/kanbus` tarball.
- GitHub repo AnthusAI/Kanbus has no webhook to `KanbusCloudFoundation` (`/internal/webhooks/github`). Live pushes do not refresh the hosted board.
- Launch checklist items for live webhook -> EFS -> IoT -> UI are still open.

## DoD
1. Signed webhook for account `anthus` project `kanbus` using a real `origin/develop` SHA produces: GitSync success, S3 `{account}/{project}/{sha}.tar.gz`, EFS Writer extract to `/mnt/data/anthus/kanbus/repo`, `.synced.json`, SyncNotify IoT publish. DLQ not growing from this run.
2. Authenticated GET `/{anthus}/{kanbus}/api/issues` returns the Kanbus board (not empty/error).
3. Browser login to `https://l90n23uqnl.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/dev/anthus/kanbus/` shows issues.
4. Record whether GitHub webhook registration is still missing; do not pretend Amplify/Snyk hooks are Kanbus sync.

## Out of scope
Merge to main. New NAT. Fargate/CodeBuild.

## Staging
Stack KanbusCloudFoundation, account 335163751677, AWS_PROFILE=default. No cdk deploy --all.
payload.title: Hosted anthus/kanbus board is unproven after S3-bridge cutover
